_comment: Labelled claims for eval_truth.py. Each claim is judged against one passage from documents/ (the premise). supported = the passage says it; contradicted = the passage says something incompatible; not_found = the passage neither says nor rules it out. Claims are paraphrased rather than copied, and contradictions include swapped names and meanings, not only numbers, so word overlap alone cannot pass.
